title: A fractional de Rham complex for coframe-attached Maxwell equations
summary: We develop a coordinate-anchored pointwise theory of fractional tangent functionals on bounded rectangles. By working on the range of the coordinatewise Riemann-Liouville integral, we define anchored fractional operators by exact inversion and prove a representation theorem: every coordinate fractional tangent functional is a scalar multiple of evaluation of the inverse operator at the base point, and the normalized one is unique.
